# Tailrocks: macOS Visual QA

`tailrocks-macos-visual-qa` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-macos-visual-qa)

Build, launch, capture, drive, and verify a native macOS app so an agent can see its own interface: window-ID capture, accessibility-tree driving, appearance and accessibility state matrix, audits, and pixel regression.
